concept.reason: Direct skeletal photographs establish required silhouette; original shape design can proceed without extra concept images. This does not replace gray-model and independent exact-export visual review.

scope: Original stylized adult Teleoceras proterum living reconstruction guided by the Florida Museum composite mount; not an individual specimen scan.

scientific_limits.en: Soft tissue, color, pose and unsourced dimensions are artistic estimates. Museum mounts may contain restored/composite elements; no specimen-exact anatomy or ecology is certified.
scientific_limits.zh: 软组织、颜色、姿态及无测量依据的尺寸为美术估值。博物馆骨架可能含复原或复合部分；不声称精确标本解剖或生态。

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: short stout legs beneath an extremely barrel-shaped rhinoceros trunk. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：极桶状犀类躯干下方的短粗腿。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block short stout legs beneath an extremely barrel-shaped rhinoceros trunk with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织极桶状犀类躯干下方的短粗腿；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained earth tones, no reference-image embedding
pose: Neutral four-foot terrestrial stance, short lowered neck, slight head turn; all four limbs visually separable.

scale.basis: All dimensions are working artistic estimates, not specimen measurements.
scale.tolerance: Length ±10%; width/height are silhouette design targets not hard scientific measurement gates.

shape_requirements: Very deep rounded barrel ribcage dominates the side and top silhouette; short stout legs remain visibly beneath rather than hidden inside the body.
Low elongated rhinoceros head, short neck, small ears, small nasal horn treated as inferred keratin covering; no hippo-wide mouth or giant horns.
Four short three-toed feet with clear contact and compact tail; no long slender Hyracodon-like limbs.
Do not achieve bulk by a featureless sphere; profile/loft chest, shoulder, haunch and tapered neck transitions.
gray_model_gate: Inspect side, front and elevated oblique at low cost before final detail; reject if original inventory shape combination is absent. No automatic scientific PASS from numeric limits.
final_evidence: Four exact-export views front/side/top/perspective; perspective may equal preview. No extra turntable or website-sized image until needed; independent reviewer judges original shape gate.
